title: Combinational Arbiter — No Reset, Grant X on Power-On
description: The grant is driven by a continuous assign with no registered reset path; at power-on before req and mask are known, gnt reflects unknown inputs and can spuriously assert.
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [SVA_XZ] gnt=2'bxx at t=0 before req/mask initialized; spurious grant during power-on
expected_root_cause: The combinational assign propagates unknown (X) values from req and mask directly to gnt before those signals are initialized; there is no reset path to guarantee gnt=0 at power-on.
rtl: assign gnt = req & ~mask;  // Combinational: gnt=X if req or mask contain X
testbench: initial begin rst_n=0; req=1; #5; rst_n=1; end
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [SVA_XZ] gnt=2'bxx at t=0 before req/mask initialized; spurious grant during power-on
success_log: gnt=2'h0 after reset. First valid grant appears after req is driven.
